inference.body:
with AudioFile(input_audio) as f:
    sr = f.samplerate
    audio = f.read(f.frames)

plugins = []
if pitch_shift != 0:
    plugins.append(PitchShift(semitones=pitch_shift))
if chorus_mix > 0:
    plugins.append(Chorus(mix=chorus_mix))
if distortion_drive > 0:
    plugins.append(Distortion(drive_db=distortion_drive))
if delay_seconds > 0 and delay_mix > 0:
    plugins.append(Delay(delay_seconds=delay_seconds, mix=delay_mix))
if reverb_wet > 0:
    plugins.append(Reverb(room_size=0.5, wet_level=reverb_wet, dry_level=1.0 - reverb_wet))
if lowpass_cutoff < 20000.0:
    plugins.append(LowpassFilter(cutoff_frequency_hz=lowpass_cutoff))
if highpass_cutoff > 20.0:
    plugins.append(HighpassFilter(cutoff_frequency_hz=highpass_cutoff))

board = Pedalboard(plugins)
effected = board(audio, sr)

out_file = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False)
out_file.close()
with AudioFile(out_file.name, 'w', sr, effected.shape[0]) as f:
    f.write(effected)

return out_file.name
